title: The Customers list has no bulk credit term change
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: You look for a way to change many customers' credit terms at once from the Customers list.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Starting screen: the Customers page.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps: 1. Look at the Customers list's buttons, menus and row actions.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: there is no action to change the credit term of several customers; Move Customers lives only on the Credit Terms page.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11680 (Story 11, Release day: what changes for existing users)

  • Out of Scope: “A bulk term change from the Customers list. Move Customers lives on the Credit Terms page only, where the term's full customer list and the default already are. A Customers-list bulk change is a possible follow-up.”
